slides.texte_overlay:
how to become the most
unshakeable person you know
Decide your values before life tests them. Honesty, loyalty, effort. Write them down. When pressure comes, you don't have to think. You already know what you'll do.
Separate what you control from what you don't. Your effort, your words, your reactions: yours. The weather, other people's moods, the economy: not yours. Focus only on the first list.
Get comfortable with discomfort on purpose. Cold showers, hard workouts, difficult conversations. Choosing small hardships makes the big unexpected ones far less scary.
Keep a short list of what's going well. Three things every night. On hard days, it reminds you that one bad moment never cancels everything good in your life.
Build a mind that's hard to shake. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and history shows how people survived far worse than my bad days.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. History shows how people survived far worse than my bad days.

slides.texte_overlay: Have a few people you can always call. A friend, a brother, a mentor. Unshakeable people aren't alone. They know exactly who to talk to when life gets heavy.
Respond slowly to big news. Good or bad, wait a day before making major decisions. A night's sleep turns most panic into a clear, calm and realistic plan.
